cards.title: What makes a polygon
cards.idea: A polygon is a closed flat shape made only of straight line segments joined end to end.

interaction.prompt: Tap the shapes that are polygons

cards.reveal: A triangle, a square and a pentagon are polygons. A circle and an open figure with a curved side are not, because a polygon needs straight sides and must be closed.

cards.title: Splitting into triangles
cards.idea: From one corner of a polygon, you can draw diagonals that split it into triangles.

interaction.prompt: Drag diagonals from one vertex of the pentagon to the other corners

cards.reveal: A pentagon splits into 3 triangles. A polygon with n sides always splits into (n minus 2) triangles from a single vertex.

cards.title: Adding up the angles
cards.idea: Since each triangle holds 180 degrees, the interior angles of a polygon add to (n minus 2) times 180 degrees.

interaction.prompt: Slide to change the number of sides n and watch the interior angle sum

cards.reveal: At n=3 the sum is 180, at n=4 it is 360, at n=5 it is 540. Each extra side adds one triangle, which adds 180 degrees.

cards.title: Regular polygons
cards.idea: In a regular polygon all sides and all angles are equal, so each interior angle equals the total sum divided by n.

interaction.prompt: A regular hexagon has 6 sides. Type the size of one interior angle in degrees

cards.reveal: The sum is (6 minus 2) times 180 = 720 degrees. Divide by 6 to get 120 degrees for each angle.

cards.title: Exterior angles
cards.idea: The exterior angles of any polygon always add up to 360 degrees, no matter how many sides it has.

interaction.prompt: Tap the exterior angle sum that stays the same for every polygon

cards.reveal: The exterior angles always total 360 degrees. So for a regular polygon each exterior angle is 360 divided by n.
